GRADE 7 CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — TERM 2 EXAM

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Time: 40 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Kenyan Indigenous Games at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe different ways of water entry in a pool,
   B. Learners should ignore Kenyan Indigenous Games completely.
   C. Kenyan Indigenous Games is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kenyan Indigenous Games.

2. About Kenyan Indigenous Games at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. perform a crouch dive into the swimming pool,
   B. Learners should ignore Kenyan Indigenous Games completely.
   C. Kenyan Indigenous Games is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kenyan Indigenous Games.

3. About Kenyan Indigenous Games when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. execute a water entry skill using a pencil dive,
   B. Learners should ignore Kenyan Indigenous Games completely.
   C. Kenyan Indigenous Games is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kenyan Indigenous Games.

5. About Rhythm at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. outline factors to consider in creating a rhythmic pattern in simple time,
   B. Learners should ignore Rhythm completely.
   C. Rhythm is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Rhythm.

6. About Rhythm at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. compose a four- bar rhythmic pattern in 2 4 time,
   B. Learners should ignore Rhythm completely.
   C. Rhythm is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Rhythm.

7. About Rhythm when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. write rhythmic patterns in 2 4 on monotone from dictation,
   B. Learners should ignore Rhythm completely.
   C. Rhythm is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Rhythm.

9. About Javelin and Sculpture at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify materials for carving in sculpture,
   B. Learners should ignore Javelin and Sculpture completely.
   C. Javelin and Sculpture is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Javelin and Sculpture.

10. About Javelin and Sculpture at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. carve a javelin according to the right specification,
   B. Learners should ignore Javelin and Sculpture completely.
   C. Javelin and Sculpture is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Javelin and Sculpture.

11. About Javelin and Sculpture when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. decorate the javelin using appropriate techniques,
   B. Learners should ignore Javelin and Sculpture completely.
   C. Javelin and Sculpture is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Javelin and Sculpture.

13. About Melody at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. outline the qualities of a good melody,
   B. Learners should ignore Melody completely.
   C. Melody is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Melody.

14. About Melody at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. compose a four-bar melody in C major,
   B. Learners should ignore Melody completely.
   C. Melody is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Melody.

15. About Melody when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. perform created pieces of music in C major,
   B. Learners should ignore Melody completely.
   C. Melody is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Melody.

17. About Handball at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe passing, dribbling and jump shot in Handball game,
   B. Learners should ignore Handball completely.
   C. Handball is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Handball.

18. About Handball at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. perform the passing skills in Handball,
   B. Learners should ignore Handball completely.
   C. Handball is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Handball.

19. About Handball when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. execute dribbling in Handball for skill acquisition,
   B. Learners should ignore Handball completely.
   C. Handball is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Handball.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Kenyan Indigenous Games at home with your family.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Rhythm at home with your family.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Javelin and Sculpture at home with your family.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Melody at home with your family.

20. Give two examples of how you can use Handball at home with your family.
